payload.claim: `_sh_in_by_path` restates the body of `saffron.projection._sh_in` (same rdflib graph parse, same `sh:path`/`sh:in` walk over a `Collection`) instead of importing the existing helper. The spec already imports `NS`, `DATA_NS`, `VOCABULARY` and `DEFAULT_SHAPES` from `saffron.projection` in this same file, so the module already depends on it; the sh:path lookup is a helper the repo already defines and this hunk restates it rather than importing it, which is exactly what the 'one source' rule in CLAUDE.md calls out even when the two copies agree today.
